The same derogation for Anglefort, a rural town.
packs/fr/municipalities.json: INSEE grille communale de densité, 2025 edition.

perimeter.source: On one parallel at 0, 12, 19 and 23 km: the greatest distance from each to another is 23, 12, 19 and 23 km against 20 km. The distances are the parallel's on the WGS 84 ellipsoid (1.00173 times the sphere's at 45.89°), held to 100 m.

operators.source: The scenario connects the meter to enedis.

settlement.source: The sawmill, outside the perimeter, is left out of the sharing (outside_perimeter); the barn roof, the other end of the pair furthest apart, is kept as the production the operation stands around (producer_outside_perimeter). The proportional key of the sharing_example engine worked by hand: at each hour the energy shared is the smaller of what the participants inject and what they take; each receives in proportion to its offtake and gives in proportion to its injection. The pool (56, 76, 76, 56 kWh) exceeds the demand of the farm and the dairy (50, 65, 75, 50 kWh) at every hour: each receives all it takes, 90 and 150 kWh.

kpis.source: The dairy has no production series: its self-consumption cannot be computed, and the model refuses rather than take it for zero.
Left out of the sharing, the sawmill has no shared series: the model refuses rather than take what it was not shared for zero.
